events.title: We’re Replacing Echo Doodle’s Artwork with Hand-Drawn Art!
events.summary: Hello, I’m the developer creating Echo Doodle on my own. Thank you to everyone who has visited the page and is taking the time to read this announcement.Echo Doodle currently includes some images created with the use of generative AI.Recently, I realized that there are far more people who feel strongly opposed to games using AI-generated artwork than I had expected. events.title: Echo Doodle Demo Update - October 12, 2026
events.summary: \Added contextual gameplay tips to the Game Over screen based on the cause of death.\Removed 1 existing upgrade.Added 1 new upgrade.\Reworked how additional Shockwaves are generated.Some Shockwave upgrades now convert into additional attacks during boss fights.

events.title: Echo Doodle Demo Update - October 3, 2026
events.summary: Update NotesBalanceAdjusted ranged enemy attack damage from 80 → 10.Adjusted ranged enemy attack interval from 2s → 0.75s.Adjusted ranged projectile travel time from 0.7s → 0.5s.UIThe low-health warning flash is now disabled while the choice popup is open when HP is below 50%.Adjusted the position of damage numbers to improve readability.AbilitiesLanding Spark's Micro Pull and Bilateral Compression effects no longer affect bosses.

events.title: Echo Doodle Demo Update - 2026.10.02
events.summary: Update NotesEvent StagesFixed an issue where Pencil enemies could move together with other enemies during the Chase Event.Added a target indicator to make the target easier to identify during the Chase Event.ChoicesRegular choices can now be refreshed up to 3 times.Press R while highlighting the choice you want to replace to refresh it.StagesImproved the terrain generation logic for regular stages.BossesDefeating a boss now increases maximum HP by 10.
